definitions.explanation: A medical professional who diagnoses and treats patients.

examples.english: I want to become a doctor.

examples.japanese: {熱|ねつ}があるので、{医者|いしゃ}に{診|み}てもらった。
examples.english: I had a fever, so I had a doctor examine me.

notes:
{医者|いしゃ} is the common word for doctor.

RELATED WORDS:
- {医者|いしゃ}: doctor (common)
- {医師|いし}: physician (formal/official)
- お{医者|いしゃ}さん: doctor (polite)
- {歯医者|はいしゃ}: dentist

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {医者|いしゃ}に{行|い}く (go to the doctor)
- {医者|いしゃ}に{診|み}てもらう (be examined by a doctor)
